title: Mathematics tutoring review
goal: An education researcher can trace screening from 980 records to 34 included studies.

rubric.must: The PRISMA diagram visibly contains the standard four flow rows.
The identification, duplicate-removal, and screened counts visibly reconcile.
Screening and eligibility exclusion side boxes visibly show totals and reasons.
The final box visibly reports 34 studies and 39 reports.
Connectors show a single unbroken review path.
